text:
alex: Quick pre-publish check for v0.9.2 — planning to push annotated tag + GH draft at 18:00 UTC. Can someone take ownership of signing + checksum verification and another person for the GH draft? I uploaded the artifacts to s3://redwood-releases/v0.9.2/.

maria: I can handle signing and checksum. Will run through the artifacts now.

sam: I added the changelog entry under Unreleased in #1234 — do you want me to move that under v0.9.2 or keep it and let draft release reference it?

maria: Move it to a new section titled v0.9.2 and include the PR link. Keeps the draft copy/paste clean.

jen: I'll create the GH draft once I get the annotated tag pushed. Ping me here when the tag exists and artifacts are checksummed.

alex: Thanks. Quick checklist: 
- [ ] Annotated tag `v0.9.2` created (signed)
- [ ] Artifacts sha256 verified against uploaded .sha256 files
- [ ] GH draft created and binaries attached
- [ ] CHANGELOG moved under v0.9.2
- [ ] Rollback plan posted if anything fails

maria: Running commands now:
```bash
cd repo
git fetch --tags
git tag -a v0.9.2 -m "v0.9.2"
gpg --armor --detach-sign -u "maria@redwood.ai" artifacts/*.tar.gz
sha256sum artifacts/*.tar.gz > artifacts/v0.9.2.sha256
```
I'll compare those to the files in s3.

release-bot: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/edit/0.9.2 (title: Draft) :rocket:

jen: Got the draft link, waiting on signed tag and checksums. I'll attach the binaries from S3 once you confirm checksums match.

vu: If we need a rollback plan: simplest is unlist the GH release, revoke the tag locally and on origin, and re-upload corrected artifacts. Quick steps I use:
```bash
# remove tag remotely
git push --delete origin v0.9.2
# delete locally
git tag -d v0.9.2
# repush fixed tag
git tag -a v0.9.2 -m "v0.9.2" && git push origin v0.9.2 --tags
# on GH: remove draft/release and create new one
```
Also keep the original SHA sums to compare.

sam: Slight nit: the CHANGELOG entry references an internal feature flag name. Can someone confirm we should keep the internal ID or use the user-facing name?

alex: Use the user-facing name (no internal IDs) in changelog. Keep internal references in PR description only.

maria: Checksums all match the .sha256 files in S3. GPG signatures created. Pushed signed tag to origin: `git push origin refs/tags/v0.9.2` and `git push origin refs/tags/v0.9.2.sig` (we store detached sigs alongside artifacts).

jen: I attached artifacts to the draft and populated the release notes with the changelog section. Leaving it in Draft for a 10m bake then will publish unless anyone objects. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: No objections from me. If anything goes sideways, follow Vu's rollback steps and @maria will re-sign after fixes. Publishing in ~10. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Release published: v0.9.2 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v0.9.2 (automated)

sam: Verified installer checksums locally against S3 post-publish. All good. :white_check_mark:

jen: Closing the draft, updating internal release tracker. Thanks team.

alex: Great work — tagging this done for eng-releases. If anyone sees post-publish regressions ping #incidents.

maria: :thumbsup:
